The focused wiring tests exercise the load-bearing selection behavior, exact-name matching, fail-open modes, event/draft guards, aggregation placement, and filer regex. The new floor and updated presence note agree on the default-feature measurement scope. No correctness, soundness, security, or vacuous-test defect is apparent in the diff.
